bio: Vunden is an oddball of a Dwarf – his kit is some of the best, but where he gets his molten rounds is anyone’s guess. Neither the Elder King nor the Deep Lords would normally tolerate a mercenary so well-equipped, but Vunden only hunts Darkborn… and ghosts. Especially ghosts. And he won’t say why.
